claim_text: Resolver V2 achieved 0.00% false merge rate and proved false merge rate < 0.1%
recommended_replacement: Resolver V2 achieved 0.00% false merges across 55 negative pairs in the benchmark (95% Wilson CI: [0.00% - 6.53%]). Proving error rate < 0.1% requires N >= 3,000 true negative pairs.

claim_text: Cryptographic SHA-256 evidence ledger verifies complete provenance across all 28 anchor employers and observations.
recommended_replacement: Evidence ledger verifies cryptographic integrity for primary source documents and bulk snapshots; individual row-level entity hashing will be introduced in Sprint 3B.3.3.

claim_text: In-memory storage on Render Free tier operates with zero OOM risk.
recommended_replacement: In-memory dataset heap (~0.84 MB for 100 employers) presents low baseline risk, but large unpaginated JSON serialization responses and concurrent query spikes present operational risk without pagination.

claim_text: Guarantees 100% empirical data lineage with zero synthetic fallback data.
recommended_replacement: Enforces strict empirical data lineage from primary government sources; requests with missing data return null/withheld status.

claim_text: 5-token contextual co-occurrence window achieves 100% precision on skill extraction.
recommended_replacement: Contextual co-occurrence filter achieved 100% accuracy on the 20 adversarial benchmark test cases. Production vacancy text requires ongoing sample size reporting.

claim_text: Confidence scores of 0.95 represent 95% mapping probability.
recommended_replacement: Heuristic mapping confidence is an uncalibrated similarity indicator. Calibrated probability requires post-hoc Platt / temperature scaling.
